title: Queue entry
description: One queue entry: who requests, who is assigned and what it is about are fields, not separate queues or records. foundry-build-0048 U5 writes kind slot only (SLOT-CREATE): a requester slot, or the owner, names a slot no agent holds; the assignee agent reuses a placed slot or creates one. Written by `clossys request` (and by `clossys ia`, `clossys feedback` and the SCOPE scan) at clossys/agents/producer/queue.slot/entries/<id>.json; `clossys request <id> --close` links the requester slot-to-slot, notifies it and closes the entry. The clossys.queue-entry/1 writers (queue.pick, queue.approve, queue.clarify, queue.fix) are unchanged; a later unit moves them to this shape. `events` is the entry's own ledger: each event has an id `<entry id>#<n>`, and `opened`/`closed` name the raising and closing events. The validator has no conditionals: kind slot needs a slot-ref target and rel, a reuse decision needs reuse and overlaps, a create decision proposal and overlaps, and a closed entry decision, link, notified, closed and closedAt (records/request.ts requestIssues).

kind.description: What is asked. pick, approve, clarify and fix are the clossys.queue-entry/1 queues; slot: a slot that does not exist yet; change: a change to a placed slot.

from.description: The requester: an agent slot ref, or the owner for a need with no requester slot.

assignee.description: Who executes the entry: an agent id, or the owner.

target.description: What the entry is about: a slot ref <agent>/<slot id> (kind slot: the slot the requester names, which no slot holds when raised) or an L2 home <agent>/<l1>/<l2>.

opened.description: The id of the raised ledger event (an id in events).

closed.description: The id of the closed ledger event (an id in events).

link.description: The closing slot ref: the slot the requester now cites (the created or reused one).

rel.description: kind slot: how the requester cites the slot once it exists.

overlaps.description: kind slot: the overlap check over the assignee's placed slots (`clossys request <id> --check`): every slot the need may duplicate.

reuse.description: decision reuse: the placed slot the requester cites instead.

proposal.description: kind slot, decision create: the new leaf the assignee proposes; the owner signs it before `ia` places it.

notified.description: The ledger event addressed to the requester when the entry closed.
